title: 🧠 Функции Present Continuous: сортировка
description: Прочитай предложение и определи функцию Present Continuous: действие сейчас, временная ситуация, планы, тенденции или раздражение.

items.verb: I am living with my aunt this week.
He is always leaving his rubbish on my desk!
We are meeting Tom at 5 PM.
Look! The journalist is broadcasting live.
More people are buying electric cars.
I am working on a school project these days.
She is constantly complaining about her job!
What time are you flying to London tomorrow?
Be quiet! The baby is sleeping.
We are having dinner with the Smiths tonight.
My sister is always taking my clothes!
I am reading a great book at the moment.
They are playing football in the park right now.
